resolution: The 'grid + buildings gone' report resolved across several fixes. Grid: it draws 4cm above ground so a fully-painted floor occludes it (not a bug). Buildings: the iso floor-level cut-away was hiding the whole multi-storey city at the low active level — fixed by a showAllFloors default-ON toggle (79da84357). Also landed on this thread: colocated z-fight dedup scoped loose-only (6704c3a80) and a non-finite ground-sample guard (2f73ae81f). The dedup and host geometry cache were investigated and ruled out as the building-vanish cause.
